purpose: Fresh local validation and reserved final identities; pretraining exposure unknown
split_rule: Exclude every reviewed training identity and previously inspected experiment identity. Hash-rank eight-photo groups. All role/split pHash distances >6 and exact hashes distinct. Validation detector-only screening; final metadata/duplicate screening only.
limitations: Dataset identity labels are not independently verified
pHash is conservative, not exhaustive transformed-duplicate detection
Detector-screened validation is not population representative

experiment.multiplicity: Holm across four primary comparisons; other metrics exploratory
